content: {"rules": ["Model forecasts consistently underestimate price spikes, especially after bullish sentiment events.", "Forecast bias is amplified when sentiment shifts from bearish to bullish, indicating lagged reaction.", "Mean-reversion patterns emerge after sustained upward price movements, suggesting model overconfidence in trend continuation.", "Sentiment and supply net balance interact to drive price overshoots, particularly when bearish sentiment dominates.", "Forecast accuracy improves when official event balance is stable, indicating reduced volatility from auction supply.", "Model forecasts exhibit upward bias during periods of high bullish sentiment, suggesting sentiment-driven overestimation.", "Price corrections follow model forecasts, indicating forecast lag and delayed market reaction to official events.", "Forecast accuracy declines when sentiment is mixed or neutral, suggesting model sensitivity to sentiment noise."]}
